simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אֱלִיאָתָה (H448) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: אֱלִיאָתָה (ʼĔlîyʼâthâh) means Eliathah , an Israelite First listed occurrence: 1Chr 25 4.

definitions.full: H448. Eliathah אֱלִיאָ֫תָה proper name, masculine ( God has come ) a Hemanite 1Chr 25:4 = אֱלִיָּתָה 25:27 . אֱלִידָד see אֶלְדָּד above
definitions.rootNote: or (contraction) אֱלִיָּתָה ; from 410 and 225 ; God of (his) consent;
